neighbours.label: a linking ' of' or ' der' inside a long descriptive noun phrase (a broad pole)
fire: It stood apart from the other former Town of York market.
Das Geld geht in den Preis der eigenen Waren ein.
He spoke about the old Earl of Essex and his lands.
Sie schreibt über den Wert der kleinen Betriebe.
It was unlike the other great City of Paris fairs.
The court rejected the claim of the former owners.
Er sprach von der Rolle der neuen Lehrer.
She wrote about the fall of the ancient Kingdom of Kush.
quiet: It stood apart from the other shops in York.
Das Geld geht in den Preis ein.
He spoke about Essex and his lands.
It was unlike the other great fairs in Paris.

short: linking ' of'/' der' in a phrase
notes: Near misses are shorter because they drop the phrase, which goes against the same-length rule, but the phrase is the claimed trigger. ' that' (0.41 in a probe) and '=self' are not covered.
